```yaml
name: Docs Automation

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_claude:
        description: 'Whether to run Claude Code'
        required: true
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
      create_pr:
        description: 'Whether to create PR in docs-new'
        required: true
        default: 'false'
        type: boolean
      max_turns:
        description: 'Max Claude turns (increase if hitting limit)'
        required: true
        default: '50'
        type: number

jobs:
  docs-automation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true' }}
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: npx claude-code --changelog CHANGELOG.md --output docs-new --max-turns ${{ github.event.inputs.max_turns }}

      - name: Create PR in docs-new
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'true' }}
        env:
          DOCS_REPO_PAT: ${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "Algolia Bot"
          git config --global user.email "bot@algolia.com"
          git remote set-url origin https://${{ github.actor }}:${{ secrets.DOCS_REPO_PAT }}@github.com/algolia/docs-new.git
          git checkout -b docs-sync-${{ github.sha }}
          git add docs-new
          git commit -m "Sync documentation for release"
          gh pr create --title "Sync documentation for release" --body "Automated PR generated by docs-automation workflow." --base main --head docs-sync-${{ github.sha }} --draft

      - name: Dry run
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'false' && github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'false' }}
        run: echo "Dry run completed. No changes made."

      - name: Preview
        if: ${{ github.event.inputs.run_claude == 'true' && github.event.inputs.create_pr == 'false' }}
        run: echo "Preview completed. Changes shown but no PR created."
```
